configuration.MCP_ISSUER: exact public Node origin, no trailing slash
configuration.MCP_PRODUCT_ORIGIN: exact Rails origin, no trailing slash
configuration.MCP_HANDOFF_SECRET: separate >=32 random byte secret per brand, used only for HMAC
configuration.MCP_BRIDGE_SECRET: different >=32 random byte bearer secret per brand

signing.format: base64url(UTF8 JSON payload) + dot + base64url(HMAC-SHA256(secret, encoded_payload))
signing.validation: Compare MAC constant-time; parse only after MAC; require exact version, issuer, audience, callback, known scopes and bounded lengths; exp greater than now; iat no more than 30 seconds ahead; exp-iat <=300; nonce >=32 random bytes in production. Never normalize untrusted URL before exact comparison. JSON field order is irrelevant to verification: sign the exact encoded bytes.

fields: account_id (Beaconed only; must be current authorized membership)
consent.behavior: Existing real login, no impersonation consent. Revalidate handoff and current owner on POST. Consent always shows escaped client name as unverified, redirect_host, chosen account, read/write powers and credit/live publication effects. Denial creates no key and redirects fixed callback with error=access_denied, interaction_id, state=nonce. Success creates the connection and stores only the redemption code digest, expires redemption within 5 minutes; redirects fixed callback with code, interaction_id, state=nonce. Never redirect to client redirect_host.

exchange.authorization: Bearer MCP_BRIDGE_SECRET; browser cookie alone insufficient
exchange.semantics: Require matching interaction/nonce and unexpired active grant before atomic consume. One successful caller only. Missing, expired, mismatched or reused code =>400 {error:invalid_grant}; wrong/missing bridge credential =>401 {error:invalid_client}. Disabled feature=>404. No secrets/codes/authorization in logs. Create the dedicated API key inside the winning redemption transaction and return it once; never precreate/persist pending raw keys. ApiKey belongs_to mcp_connection via optional FK; revoke grants rather than deleting them and restrict deletion so a delegated key never becomes ordinary.

connection.inactive: 200 {active:false} for expired/revoked/unknown or currently unauthorized grant; no credential ever returned
connection.delete: DELETE same internal path revokes grant and dedicated key; idempotent204, authenticated bridge only
connection.customer_revoke: DELETE /mcp/connections/:connection_id with real login, account ownership/policy and CSRF; never allow user-editable key name to establish grant binding

authority.alttext: kept user and account; user.account_id equals grant.account_id; ordinary user permitted; no platform admin implication
authority.beaconed: current Membership through role_for(account), grant creation follows ApiKeyPolicy, downgrades/removal immediately invalidate authority; never system user.role
authority.scope: mcp:read required for safe reads; mcp:write required for create/update/destroy. Check at every upstream API request including when OAuth token remains valid. Grant lifetime max90days. Ordinary keys unchanged.
